intro.narration: [excited] Heey — how do you spot a multiple of eleven? [pause] No dividing needed.

steps.narration: [curious] Three thousand nine hundred fifty-eight. [pause] Does eleven go in?
[confident] From the right, alternate plus and minus. [pause] Eight minus five plus nine minus three.
[thoughtful] Nine isn't a multiple of eleven. [pause] So no — and nine is the remainder.
[warm] One catch — zero isn't the only pass. [pause] Two thousand nine hundred fifteen gives eleven, which passes too.
